_status: Planned, not implemented. No project exists under this directory yet -- this manifest exists so extension discovery reports it honestly (found, but no assembly to load) instead of silently omitting it. Originally shipped with fields this schema doesn't support (top-level id/name/author-as-object instead of a nested metadata block, plus a fictional entryPoint naming a class that was never written) -- found and fixed in Phase 7, see docs/verification/phase-7/README.md. Backlogged as v2 work, same as AI Tools.
